rationale: The continuation thesis is intact — price still holds above VWAP ($42.55) and the 9-EMA ($42.71) with relative strength against a weak SPY, and the stall at $42.77 came on fading volume (877 vs 2494) rather than heavy distribution, so the $42.69 invalidation has not been threatened.
